text_block_list.text: (Ring ring ring ring ring...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaaah-tatatatatata...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! I-I-I made it in tiiime~...!!
choice_data_list: Ah, that was close, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeees...! I'm sorry, Trainer, it's because 
I walked too slowly...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the weather was so nice today, and 
basking in the sun just made me feel so 
warm and fuzzy inside...!
choice_data_list:
Now, now. Let's just head to our seats for 
now.

text_block_list.text:
Early morning, October. Rine Kraft and I 
were boarding a Shinkansen bound for 
Kyoto. As for the reason why—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the weather over in Kyoto will 
stay clear all through the afternoon too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
For Sweep-san's "Shuka Sho"... it looks 
like we'll have clear skies and good track 
conditions.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to Sweep's race
I'm looking forward to Sweep's race

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, SOOOOO much!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer. There's actually 
something I'd like you to look at with 
me."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of travel time left. 
Is it alright?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This is footage from an interview. 
Conducted after this year's Oka Sho—with 
Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~? What's with that boooring 
story?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘When people think of the pinnacle of 
dreams, they think of the Japanese Derby, 
so naturally, the girls who competed there 
seem to have more glittering records’...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Do girls from the Tiara route inevitably 
get overpowered when facing the Triple 
Crown contenders in the Senior class?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"So in the end, in terms of sheer base 
ability, the Triple Crown girls are 
superior to the Triple Tiara girls"... is 
that it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's ridiculous! Just because that's how 
it's always been doesn't mean it'll stay 
that way forever!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to our race results, we 
won't know a siiiiingle thing until we 
actually run and see who's stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me. I'm a magical girl. And 
magic is all about overturning every 
single piece of boring common sense!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why don't I show you? The true magic of 
racing!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Amazing. No matter how many times I watch 
it, it's amazing... It's super, super 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san said it. Triple Crown or Tiara, 
none of that matters... She's going to 
prove that "the truly strong Umamusume is 
the winner."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll race against the Triple Crown 
contenders in the Senior Class. And I'm 
definitely gonna win to put them in their 
place!

Memories from before signing the contract 
suddenly resurface. If I recall correctly, 
back then, Line Craft also—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Claim the Triple Tiara. And then, in the 
Senior Class races, face off against the 
Triple Crown contenders.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely win! And prove the 
strength of us Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because they really are strong. Those 
girls... all of us!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right. ...Sweep-san is already 
standing beyond where my dream lies!

Rhein Kraft clenched her fist and spoke 
emphatically. She believed in Sweep 
Tosho's "strength" with all her heart.

In truth, Sweep Tosho is currently still 
just an Umamusume without a GⅠ victory. 
Even so, believing that she could—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm sure Sweep will pull it off. 
She's going to show us magic!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Surely... even today—!!
—Waaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Sweep Tosho on the outside! 
Sweep Tosho bursts forward in a single 
surge!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! Sweep Tosho surges past from 
behind!! With a half-length lead—she 
crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fearsome late kick! The final tiara of 
the Shuka Sho shines atop the head of the 
little witch, Sweep Tosho!
(Waaaaaaaaahhhhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding me, Sweep Tosho...! 
Wasn't she still near the very back at the 
fourth corner!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, she was in 16th 
place, so... Does that mean she blew past 
15 runners in one go!? That's craaazy...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. After the Oka Sho, that girl was 
talking about some pretty grand things, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...A magic that defies all common 
sense... If it's her, maybe she really can 
show it to us...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san...!! Sweep-san, Sweep-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible, amazing, incredible, 
amazing!! The seniors on the Tiara route 
really are all such incredible 
Umamusume!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Trainer, Trainer, um, I...!! 
I... I...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

With an expression that practically 
screamed, "I'm so overwhelmed with 
emotion, words fail me!" Line Craft hopped 
up and down, prompting a smile before 
speaking.
choice_data_list: You're right. You're up next, Craft.
Yeah. It's your turn next, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First, I'll take on the Hanshin JF! 
And then, once next year comes—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara is mine!" "The Triple 
Tiara shall be mine."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, look, we're all here. Hi, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa!? Heart-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course♪ There's no way we could 
miss out on seeing it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Because that's a race I absolutely must 
win next year.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. ...That's right, that line earlier, 
the Triple Tiara. Once again... there's 
one more thing we share.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So your next goal is the Hanshin JF, too? 
—Same here.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Heart-san is running the Hanshin JF 
too...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems that will be the first 
battle between you and me on the big 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm really looking forward to it, 
Craft! Let's give it everything we've got 
and compete♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll surpass you—even at your absolute 
best.

"...The next day. Rhine Kraft showed up 
for the meeting with a grave expression."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, it's about Heart-san...!
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...I looked into it on my end too.
Yeah. ...I did some digging on my end too.

text_block_list.text:
Speaking, I spread out the materials. 
—Daring Heart. An Umamusume exchange 
student from America.

Her mother was an Umamusume from a 
prominent American family, and her father 
an entrepreneur. For a time, they both 
worked at an Umamusume training club in 
Japan—

That connection led to their meeting and 
marriage. Before Daring Heart was old 
enough to remember, she crossed over to 
America with her mother.

...However, what's truly noteworthy is the 
journey she took from then until her 
arrival at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"She said... 'I felt it was destiny.' 
After watching Japan's Triple Tiara 
races."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the queen there was her destiny. 
She said she felt it strongly, so very 
strongly.

"...And Daring Heart crossed over to Japan 
all on her own, aiming to run in the 
Twinkle Series."

And what gave her a tremendous push 
forward was none other than—the "Hillesta 
Academy."

It was the Umamusume training club where 
Daring Heart's parents once met, and...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I know the name of that club too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I don't think there's a single 
girl aiming for the racing world who 
hasn't heard the name "Jiluesta Academy."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's Japan's largest Umamusume training 
club. With top-class coaches and a 
state-of-the-art training environment. An 
incredible racing academy equipped with 
everything...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We've also produced many Umamusume who 
have achieved great success in the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
They say that if you pass Tracen Academy's 
entrance exams and aim for the racing 
world, joining them first is the quickest 
shortcut.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san had her strength recognized by 
that very 'Hillesta Academy,' and received 
their full backing."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
With a single-minded determination to 
"claim the Triple Tiara"... she came to 
Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list:
She's got a remarkably strong will and a 
lot of potential.

She's got a remarkably strong will and a 
lot of potential, doesn't she.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

As for Daring Heart's track record so far, 
she narrowly took second place in her 
debut race, but lived up to being the 
first favorite by winning her maiden race.

Her true ability remains an unknown 
quantity, but... there is no doubt she is 
an opponent we must be wary of.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're in the same class, I've run 
against her a few times in mock races and 
the like, but—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san is just like me, a front-runner 
who likes to stay near the lead."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If we go with the same strategy... it will 
definitely turn into a fight for position.
choice_data_list:
Then, we've gotta build up enough stamina 
so we won't lose.

Then, we'll have to build up enough 
stamina so we won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san is... undeniably strong. But in 
the Hanshin JF, I won't lose either!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I look forward to our training session!
